NONE of the three accents passes AA at body size on ivory, so each ships with a paired darker ink for text; values are in the architecture doc section 8. That question was never asked on the kickoff call.

Felicia's 13 sections consolidated into these pages IS the contracted scope; un-consolidating any of them is a change order.

deliverables.name: MS 4 - Donate Page + Contact Form (built, NOT wired)
